help.batch_convert_content:
MosaicView chen chorgh batch chenmoH, neH poSmoH mIllogh mojaq. wa' chenmoH rIntaH:
• CBR → CBZ: choH Hoch CBR (RAR) qach.
• CB7 → CBZ: choH Hoch CB7 (7-Zip) qach.
• CBT → CBZ: choH Hoch CBT (TAR) qach.
• PDF → CBZ: choH Hoch PDF qach.
• mIllogh mob → CBZ: chenmoH wa' CBZ cha'nob mob.
• De' mung qaw teq: Sam De' (pong, naQ, ghItlhwI'pu'…) ComicVine Hoch De'wI' (CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT, PDF).
• paqmey je chenmoH: tay'moH Hoch De'wI' qach paqmey je MosaicView (*.mvdb).
• rar mIw rar tlhIngan CBZ De'wI': lo' De'wI' Hoch CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT.

help.metadata_content:
MosaicView ComicVine De'wI'mey qaw vIlo' (pongmey, SepHom, mIw, ghItlhwI'pu', mu'mey...) ComicVine De'wI'vo' - ghom qaw veS.

mIw wa': SoQ paq, toolbar pagh menu De' mung qaw yIwIv. cha' pong tIr: wa'DIch SepHom wIv, ghIq episod wIv. De' mung qaw ComicInfo.xml qon.

mIw batch: natlh(mey) tay' yIwIv 'ej toolbar pagh menu De' mung qaw teywI' pagh yIwIv. Hoch De'wI' nej (CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT, PDF). De'wI'mey Hoch CBZ moj lujDI' De' mung qaw.

buq lo': ComicVine buq lo'lu' paq De' laDmeH. mIw ngoQ'a' comicvine.gamespot.com Daq yIchenmoH. mI' chu' DIvI' ra'ghomvaD yIlInbe': DPAPI Windows ngaqmeH mI' vISeHbe', 'ej Windows account-lIj neH laDlaH.

buq HoS: ComicVine buq HoS, wanI'mey Hutlh:
• 200 nIS lup vatlh Hutlh.
• 100 De' qun nIS Hoch, episodmey SepHom nIS.
• 1 nIS lup Hutlh. MosaicView cha' lup wIj nIS Hoch, vaj HoS teblu'bogh natlhHa'be'.

ComicVine chan mIw: ComicVine chan qaStaHvIS chaH mIw, qan pagh chu' rar. MosaicView chaH cha' Sov.
• mIw chu': comicvine.gamespot.com/.../4000-XXXXX episod, comicvine.gamespot.com/.../4050-XXXXX SepHom.
• mIw qan: comicvine.com/.../37-XXXXX episod (mI' pIH tIH rar pong; Daq pagh puqlogh neH chu').
